title: STARTEX — Rising Watch on the Cedar River

fields.location: Tallis County EOC, Courthouse annex, Cedar Ford, Iowa: Cedar River reach, Levee and Drainage District No. 3 levee, Pump Stations 1 and 2
fields.weather: Overcast with light rain, 48°F. Wind SE 10 mph. This is the end of the wettest April in years.
fields.load: Normal Tuesday: schools open, no road closures, the wastewater plant is treating normal flow
fields.staffing: Monitoring: Deputy Coordinator Hannah Brandvold alone in the EOC, Coordinator Marcus Ellery and the Levee Superintendent on the phone, PIO Josie Pruitt on the way in
fields.narration: EXERCISE, EXERCISE, EXERCISE. It is 06:00 CDT on Tuesday, 20 April 2027, in Cedar Ford, with light rain falling after the wettest April in years. TCEMA is at Monitoring, and nothing in the county is out of the ordinary yet. The duty officer has just handed you a test-marked printout. It is the National Weather Service Quad Cities flood warning issued at 5:15 AM today. It says that at 5:00 AM the Cedar River at Cedar Ford (CFDI4) stood at 12.4 feet, with action stage at 13.0 feet and flood stage at 15.0 feet. The forecast is minor flooding: the river rises above flood stage late Wednesday and crests near 18.2 feet at 6:00 AM Friday. At 15.0 feet, water covers Riverside Park and River Road south of Mill Street, and basements on Water Street flood. At 17.0 feet, the Mill Street underpass floods. Play begins now.

status.note: Treating normal flow. Access road open.

fields.facilitatorNote: Hand each table a copy of the 5:15 AM NWS test printout from the MSEL before reading. Do not prompt for an activation level. Let the Coordinator decide it and state the basis.
fields.scenarioTitle: Eighteen Hours — Rising Crest, Evacuation Clock & Levee Fight

instructorNote: Players should see that a flood warning for CFDI4 with an 18.2 ft crest meets the EOP 5 trigger for Partial activation. Watch for the Coordinator to record the 12.4 ft reading and the 5:15 AM Tuesday issuance as the basis, then call in Command, Operations, the PIO and the Public Works and Sheriff liaisons, and for the room to confirm that 18.2 ft is minor under the EOP 2 table. The in-scenario date (Tuesday 20 April 2027) comes from the MSEL row and differs from the conduct date (Thursday 12 November 2026). Explain this if players ask.
